Definition: Dumah, a tribe and region of Arabia
BiblicalUsage: Dumah was a son of Ishmael, named among the twelve princes of his line, and the name also stands for the Arabian tribe and region that came from him. Isaiah's oracle cries to the watchman from Dumah, asking what of the night.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Dumah's place in the record is a mercy: Ishmael's sons are named one by one, because God remembered the boy He promised to make a nation. The watchman's cry from Dumah is still the question every night-watchman asks.
